uistat_anchor_red_text.en: Across the big lough we were going, But sadly a great gale was blowing. We stopped on the shore, Built a fire and did more, But that was the end of the rowing.
uistat_anchor_red_text.zh: 我们正要横渡那片大湖，可惜狂风大作，浪涛汹涌。我们只好停靠在岸，升起篝火，还有其他事忙活，但旅程就此终结，再也划不了桨。
